record.field: Lie on bench with feet flat on floor. Grip barbell slightly wider than shoulder width. Lower bar to chest, then press back up to starting position. Keep back flat and core engaged throughout the movement.
Builds chest strength and muscle mass. Develops tricep and anterior deltoid power. Improves upper body pushing strength.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, bar over mid-foot. Hinge at hips, grip bar just outside legs. Keep back flat, chest up. Drive through heels to stand up, lock out hips at top.
Builds total body strength. Develops posterior chain muscles. Increases overall power and functional fitness.
Hang from bar with palms facing away, shoulder-width apart. Pull body up until chin clears bar. Lower back to full extension with control.
Builds back width and bicep strength. Improves grip strength and upper body pulling power.
Start at a comfortable pace. Maintain good posture with shoulders relaxed. Land mid-foot and push off with each stride. Breathe rhythmically throughout.
Improves cardiovascular fitness. Burns calories effectively. Strengthens leg muscles and bones.
Start in forearm position with elbows under shoulders. Keep body straight from head to heels. Engage core and glutes. Hold position without letting hips sag or rise.
Builds core stability and endurance. Improves posture. Strengthens the entire midsection.
Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing forward. Keeping elbows at sides, curl weights up toward shoulders. Squeeze biceps at top, lower slowly back to starting position.
Isolates and develops bicep muscles. Improves arm strength and size. Enhances grip strength.
